title: Abelian sheaves on a site have enough injectives
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site in the sense of Stacks Sites, Definition 00VH (a category whose objects form a set, with a set $\operatorname{Cov}(\mathcal C)$ of families $\{U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}$ such that isomorphisms are coverings, coverings of the members of a covering compose to a covering, and for a covering $\{U_t\to U\}$ and a morphism $V\to U$ the fibre products $U_t\times_UV$ exist and $\{U_t\times_UV\to V\}$ is a covering), and let $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ be the category of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C$ (presheaves of abelian groups $\mathcal F$ such that $\mathcal F(U)\to\prod_t\mathcal F(U_t)\rightrightarrows\prod_{t,t'}\mathcal F(U_t\times_UU_{t'})$ is an equalizer for every covering). Then $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ is an abelian category with enough injectives: every abelian sheaf is a subobject of an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$.

mathlib_match.how: a few Mathlib declarations, one per clause. Setting: a site C (objects and morphisms sets) is a `SmallCategory C` (C : Type v). (0) Topology and sheaves: the coverings form a `Coverage C` K (K X = the presieves `Presieve.ofArrows` of the families {U_t -> U} in Cov; the axiom `Coverage.pullback` holds by site axiom (iii): for V -> U the covering {U_t x_U V -> V} factors through {U_t -> U} along V -> U); J = K.toGrothendieck (Stacks 00ZC(1)). A presheaf of abelian groups F is a sheaf in Stacks' sense iff F is in `Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}`: `Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget` (Sites/Sheaf.lean:730) reduces to the underlying presheaf of sets, `Presieve.isSheaf_coverage` (Sites/Coverage.lean:402) reduces sheaf-for-J to `IsSheafFor` each covering presieve, and `Equalizer.Presieve.Arrows.sheaf_condition` (Sites/EqualizerSheafCondition.lean:361, family indexed with duplicates allowed, pairwise fibre products existing by axiom (iii)) identifies `IsSheafFor (ofArrows U f)` with Stacks' equalizer F(U) -> prod F(U_t) => prod F(U_t x_U U_t') (the equalizer in Ab is the one in sets); so Ab(C) and `Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat` are the same full subcategory of the presheaf category (Stacks 00ZC(2)). (1) Abelian: `CategoryTheory.sheafIsAbelian` (Sites/Abelian.lean:40), with `HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}` from the instance at Sites/LeftExact.lean:308 (C small). (2) Enough injectives: `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.instIsGrothendieckAbelian` (Abelian/GrothendieckAxioms/Sheaf.lean:71, C small, A = AddCommGrpCat.{v}, which is `IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v}` by the instance at Algebra/Category/Grp/AB.lean:109) gives `IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat)`, and `IsGrothendieckAbelian.enoughInjectives` (EnoughInjectives.lean:380, @[stacks 079H]) gives `EnoughInjectives`. For an essentially small (not small) C, `Sheaf.isGrothendieckAbelian_of_essentiallySmall` (GrothendieckAxioms/Sheaf.lean:77) replaces (2). Mathlib proves enough injectives by Stacks 079H (Grothendieck category), not by the transfinite construction of 01DP; same statement.
